node.title: Rank-eleven heavy pairs compile to a small-core order-32 seed
node.closure: actual-record cross-pair compiler with exact singleton and shared-core charges
node.statement: Every over-budget deployed KoalaBear post-near error-rank-eleven line contains 32 distinct actual records of support-local margin at most 387 whose exact selected supports have common intersection smaller than K-4922. The proof charges singleton minimizing-pair owners by Q_10(387)=869784434119. If the remaining heavy pairs shared K-4922 coordinates, shortening and fixed-pair multiplicity would cap the complete line at 274791086998147432<B_*. Otherwise all heavy-pair component differences lie in the same ten-dimensional explanation direction code, so one anchor and at most ten further heavy pairs recover the complete heavy core; two owned slopes per selected pair force at most 22 supports into that core, and distinct low-margin records pad to order 32. The output preserves line, slope, explanation, support, minimizing pair, and chronology but is not yet classified or paid.
